newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHENS BOURSE SAYS ELVIEMEK UNDER PROBATION.
newsitem.headline: ATHENS BOURSE SAYS ELVIEMEK UNDER PROBATION.

text.p: The Athens stock exchange said on Thursday that Elviemek will be placed under probation effective Friday March 7 and for a period of two months.
Listed companies which fail to abide by the bourse's regulations or face serious financial problems will be placed under probation as per a previous decision by stock exchange authorities.
The rationale for the probation list is to have the investment public fully aware of a company's financial situation, it said.
On Thursday shares of Elviemek gained 29 drachmas to close at 449.
